actions: 져니가 방문을 향해 전력으로 달려나가며 프레임을 벗어난다.
motions: Journey shoves the telescope hard; it tips and crashes to the floor with a thud.
Journey sprints toward the door and exits the frame, leaving the room empty and still.

actions: 아빠가 침대에서 일어나 창가의 망원경 쪽으로 걸어간다.
아빠가 망원경에 손을 얹고 황동 경통을 천천히 어루만진다.
motions: Dad rises from the bed and walks steadily toward the telescope by the moonlit window.
Dad runs his weathered hand slowly along the brass barrel of the telescope.

actions: char_3가 전선을 손으로 잡아당기며 이상 여부를 점검한다.
motions: char_3 scratches his head slowly, eyes scanning the tangle of cables.
char_3 gently tugs a thick cable and traces it along the rack with his fingers.

actions: 엄마가 책상 위의 서류들을 한 번에 거칠게 밀어낸다.
엄마가 빈 책상 위에 커다란 지도를 펼친다.
motions: She sweeps a pile of papers off the desk with a single forceful motion, scattering them to the floor.
She unfolds a large paper map and spreads it flat across the cleared desk.
